text.p: GreenMan Technologies Inc said Monday it completed the acquisition of BFI Tire Recyclers of Minnesota Inc and BFI Tire Recyclers of Georgia Inc from Browning-Ferris Industries.
Under the terms of the deal, GreenMan paid a total of about $5.4 million for all the outstanding common stock of the two BFI tire recycling subsidiaries.
BFI retained substantially all of the fixed liabilities of the two subsidiaries.
The purchase price is subject to reduction, within 45 days, based upon completion of a final determination of accounts receivable and inventory as of June 30.
GreenMan has paid BFI $650,000 in cash, and the balance is in the form of a 90-day note payable.
The company said it expects to refinance the note through traditional asset-based financing.
As new GreenMan subsidiaries, these businesses will operate as GreenMan Technologies of Minnesota Inc and GreenMan Technologies of Georgia Inc.
GreenMan Technologies makes and sells what it called "environmentally friendly" rubber and plastic-based products.
